super-earth.title: Super Earth
super-earth.description: Super Earth is the center of the Federation and the governing power behind the Helldivers, SEAF, and humanity's expansion throughout the galaxy.

managed-democracy.title: Managed Democracy
managed-democracy.description: Managed Democracy is Super Earth's computerized voting system. Citizens answer questions and an algorithm determines which candidates best represent their choices, which Super Earth presents as eliminating the uncertainty of older democratic systems.

liberty-day.title: Liberty Day
liberty-day.description: Liberty Day is one of Super Earth's most important patriotic holidays and is celebrated annually on October 26. The holiday commemorates Managed Democracy and the citizens and soldiers who defend Super Earth's way of life. Traditions include re-swearing the Oath of Citizenship, watching the televised Lunar Bombardment, gathering gifts from town pyres, and celebrating the achievements of Super Earth and the Helldivers.

super-earth-national-anthem.title: Super Earth National Anthem
super-earth-national-anthem.description: The Super Earth National Anthem is the official musical anthem of Super Earth and celebrates the Federation, Managed Democracy, sacrifice, liberty, and humanity's supremacy across the galaxy. Instrumental versions of the anthem accompany patriotic activities such as raising the Super Earth Flag during Spread Democracy missions. The anthem also appears as an official track on the Helldivers 2 soundtrack.

malevelon-creek-memorial-day.title: Malevelon Creek Memorial Day
malevelon-creek-memorial-day.description: Malevelon Creek Memorial Day is a Super Earth holiday observed every year on April 3 in remembrance of the Helldivers who died fighting for Malevelon Creek. The holiday was established by presidential decree following the planet's liberation during the Second Galactic War. Citizens commemorate the fallen by dedicating three full minutes of their lunch break to solemn remembrance, while Helldivers were originally issued the Fallen Hero's Vengeance cape to carry the memory of the fallen into battle.

festival-of-reckoning.title: Festival of Reckoning
festival-of-reckoning.description: The Festival of Reckoning is Super Earth's winter holiday celebration, traditionally lasting three days and dedicated to love, family, peace, commerce, and vengeance against the enemies of Managed Democracy. Citizens gather with friends and family, purchase discounted consumer goods, sing holiday carols, and watch televised coverage of Helldiver victories. The celebration is supported by the annual Reckoning Fund, which finances additional ordnance for the Helldivers. The festival also includes traditions such as a dissident execution parade and the Feast of the Electorate.

feast-of-the-electorate.title: Feast of the Electorate
feast-of-the-electorate.description: The Feast of the Electorate is a celebration held during the Festival of Reckoning in honor of Super Earth's first free and Managed Election. It traditionally occurs on the third and final day of the Festival of Reckoning and represents the political culmination of the holiday's celebrations of family, peace, patriotism, and Managed Democracy.

reckoning-fund.title: Reckoning Fund
reckoning-fund.description: The Reckoning Fund is an allocation of resources set aside each year for the Festival of Reckoning. Rather than being devoted solely to civilian festivities, the fund finances additional ordnance and military activities so the Helldivers can deliver vengeance against the enemies of Super Earth for citizens to witness. Portions of the fund have also been used for experimental Stratagem testing during Festival campaigns.

super-earth-flag.title: Super Earth Flag
super-earth-flag.description: The Super Earth Flag is one of the Federation's most recognizable patriotic symbols and represents Super Earth, Managed Democracy, and humanity's authority across the galaxy. Helldivers deploy the flag during Spread Democracy operations, defending the area while it is raised over enemy-controlled territory. An instrumental version of the Super Earth National Anthem plays during the ceremony, turning the battlefield objective into a highly visible declaration of Super Earth sovereignty.

c-01-permit.title: C-01 Permit
c-01-permit.description: The C-01 Permit is a government authorization required before Super Earth citizens perform any act that could result in the conception of a child. The permit forms part of the Federation's population-control system and requires citizens to submit an application for government approval. C-01 availability has also been influenced by events in the Galactic War, with Super Earth suspending or increasing permit approvals in response to military and economic circumstances.

citizenship-classification-structure.title: Citizenship Classification Structure
citizenship-classification-structure.description: The Citizenship Classification Structure is the system used by the Federation to divide citizens into social classes. Six classes are currently known, ranging from Class A through Class F. Citizenship status can be influenced by service to Super Earth, with military personnel and their families sometimes receiving improved citizenship classifications as rewards for exceptional democratic service.

freedom-act.title: FREEDOM Act
freedom-act.description: The FREEDOM Act, formally the Freedom & Readiness to Enable Effective Defense & Obstruction of Mind-Influence Act of 2184, was enacted in response to the threat of Illuminate mind control and genetic manipulation. The law expanded the Ministry of Unity's authority to combat internal and external threats, created a new loyalty-enforcement security force known as the Unity Corps, and authorized construction of the Center for Civilian Surveillance and Safety on Mastia.

wall-of-martyrs.title: Wall of Martyrs
wall-of-martyrs.description: The Wall of Martyrs is a Super Earth monument dedicated to members of the Helldivers and SEAF who die in service to the Federation. The names of fallen soldiers are inscribed upon the Wall, with Super Earth broadcasts claiming that millions of names are added every day. The monument is frequently referenced in military messaging, equipment descriptions, and propaganda, although its physical appearance has never been officially shown.

minor-barrier-reef.title: Minor Barrier Reef
minor-barrier-reef.description: The Minor Barrier Reef is a landmark located in Sector 1 of Super Earth. It was formerly known as the Great Barrier Reef, reflecting the Federation's renaming of the historic terrestrial landmark. Although little additional information is currently documented about it, the Minor Barrier Reef is one of the surviving named geographic landmarks connecting modern Super Earth to humanity's pre-Federation past.

presidential-security-bunker.title: Presidential Security Bunker
presidential-security-bunker.description: The Presidential Security Bunker is a fortified government facility located in Prosperity City and intended to protect the President of Super Earth during major emergencies. During the final Illuminate assault on Prosperity City in 2185, Great Host forces breached the bunker. The sitting President was killed in action while defending the facility with only a pistol, after which presidential authority was temporarily transferred to the Ministry of Defense.

victory-day.title: Victory Day
victory-day.description: Victory Day commemorates Super Earth's victory over the Illuminate Great Host during the Battle for Super Earth. The observance honors the millions of citizens and defenders who died during the invasion, including those who fought at Equality-on-Sea and the President who was killed during the siege of Prosperity City. In 2186, the first anniversary was preceded by the Victory Day Crusade, during which Helldivers were ordered to carry the war into Illuminate territory while continuing to defend Super Earth.

maximum-security-cities.title: Maximum Security Cities
maximum-security-cities.description: Maximum Security Cities are heavily fortified Super Earth cities designed to provide exceptional protection against dissidents, thoughtcriminals, and other threats to Managed Democracy. Their security systems include high-definition facial recognition cameras throughout buildings and city blocks, increased foot and drone patrols, and dedicated surveillance satellites. The first three Maximum Security Cities were constructed on Fort Union, Emeria, and Fort Sanctuary and named New Hope City, New Aspiration City, and New Yearning City.

405th-cyberwarfare-detachment.title: 405th Cyberwarfare Detachment
405th-cyberwarfare-detachment.description: The 405th Cyberwarfare Detachment is a Super Earth cyberwarfare formation associated with the decisive Fort Union cyberattack during the Battle for Super Earth. After a former satellite technician developed malware capable of disabling Illuminate technology, Helldivers defended Fort Union long enough for the code to be transmitted through the planet's long-range satellites. The malware disabled a significant portion of the Great Host, and the technician responsible received a field promotion to command the 405th Cyberwarfare Detachment.

maximum-security-city-construction-site.title: Maximum Security City Construction Site
maximum-security-city-construction-site.description: Maximum Security City Construction Sites were Super Earth points of interest established on Emeria, Fort Union, and Fort Sanctuary following Major Order A2-7-5. The sites were used to construct the Federation's first three Maximum Security Cities: New Aspiration City, New Hope City, and New Yearning City. The completed cities were designed with extensive security measures including high-definition facial recognition cameras, increased foot and drone patrols, and dedicated surveillance satellites.

terminid-research-preserve.title: Terminid Research Preserve
terminid-research-preserve.description: The Terminid Research Preserve was a planet-wide Super Earth quarantine facility established on Acamar IV. The preserve allowed researchers to study live Terminids and provided a large supply of specimens for E-710 extraction and scientific research. Its containment measures included SEAF Wardens, above- and below-ground electrical fencing, and automatic nuclear bombardment protocols. The preserve was ultimately destroyed after a catastrophic subterranean Terminid outbreak erupted beneath Tyranny Park and spread to neighboring planets.

tyranny-park.title: Tyranny Park
tyranny-park.description: Tyranny Park was a public attraction located within the Terminid Research Preserve on Acamar IV. Wealthy Super Earth citizens could visit the park to observe Terminids in a controlled environment, while particularly adventurous visitors could participate in Big Tyrant Hunts. Revenue from the attraction was intended to support Terminid research and E-710 production. The park became the site of disaster when a massive subterranean Terminid hive erupted beneath it during the catastrophic failure of the preserve.
